## Overview

This is an introductory course in R, aimed at complete beginners.

Please be aware that this course is in development and the contents of this site are likely to change in the future.

::: {.callout-tip icon="false"}
### [{{< fa regular lightbulb >}}]{style="color: #872046;"} Learning outcomes

:::

## Target audience

This course is designed for those who are new to R/RStudio with little or no coding experience. It is not aimed at a specific discipline, and the examples and exercises are designed to be broadly applicable across a range of subject areas.

## Prerequisites

There are no prerequisites in terms of R coding experience.

For the live workshop, participants will need access to a laptop with R and RStudio installed. Instructions for downloading R and RStudio are available <a href="https://surreylearn.surrey.ac.uk/d2l/le/lessons/215610/topics/2917721" target="_blank" rel="noopener">here</a>.

## Workshop code & templates

The material in this course lines up with the *Getting started with R & RStudio* workshop delivered by MASA.

Code and examples taken directly from the workshop are shown in green panels like the one below, so you can easily match what you see here to the live workshop materials.

The materials also include additional syntax, examples, and explanations to complement the workshop, and can be used as an extension or self-study resource.
